title: Daniel Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Daniel 4: the king's dream of the great tree, the watcher who called for it to be cut down, and the king driven out to eat grass.

questions.text: What troubled Nebuchadnezzar while he was at rest in his house and flourishing in his palace?
questions.explanation: He says he saw a dream which made him afraid, and the thoughts on his bed and the visions of his head troubled him.

answers.text: A rebellion in the provinces
A writing on the wall of his palace
A voice from the den of lions
A dream and the visions of his head

questions.text: Who came in first but could not make known the interpretation of the dream?
questions.explanation: The magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in and he told them the dream, but they did not make known its interpretation.

answers.text: The local governors and the deputies
The magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans and soothsayers
The priests of the temple in Jerusalem
His counselors and all his lords

questions.text: By what name does the king call Daniel, given according to the name of the king's god?
questions.explanation: Daniel came in before him, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of the king's god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods.

answers.text: Belteshazzar
Abednego
Belshazzar
Ashpenaz

questions.text: What did the king see in the middle of the earth in the visions of his head?
questions.explanation: He saw a tree in the middle of the earth whose height was great; it grew strong and its height reached to the sky and its sight to the end of all the earth.

answers.text: An image of gold standing on a plain
Four great animals coming up from the sea
A tree whose height reached to the sky
A stone cut out of a mountain

questions.text: Who came down from the sky and cried aloud to cut down the tree?
questions.explanation: He saw a watcher and a holy one come down from the sky, who cried aloud to cut down the tree and cut off its branches.

answers.text: A man clothed in linen
A watcher and a holy one
Gabriel the messenger
A multitude of angels

questions.text: According to the interpretation, whom did the great tree stand for?
questions.explanation: Daniel said the tree that grew and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, is the king himself, whose greatness has grown and whose dominion reaches to the end of the earth.

answers.text: The city of Babylon
The kingdom of the Medes
The Most High God
The king himself

questions.text: What did the interpretation say would happen to the king?
questions.explanation: The decree of the Most High was that he would be driven from men, his dwelling would be with the animals of the field, he would be made to eat grass as oxen, and seven times would pass over him.

answers.text: He would be cast into a burning fiery furnace
He would be slain that same night
He would be driven from men and eat grass as oxen
He would be carried away to the land of Shinar

questions.text: What did the king say while walking in the royal palace of Babylon?
questions.explanation: He said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place, by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?”

answers.text: That he had built great Babylon by the might of his power
That the Most High rules in the kingdom of men
That his kingdom had departed from him
That he would offer an offering to Daniel's God

questions.text: What happened to the king's hair and nails while he was driven from men?
questions.explanation: He ate grass as oxen and his body was wet with the dew of the sky, until his hair had grown like eagles' feathers and his nails like birds' claws.

answers.text: His hair turned white as snow and his nails fell out
His hair was singed and his nails were burned
His hair was shaved and his nails were cut
His hair grew like eagles' feathers and his nails like birds' claws

questions.text: What happened at the end of the days when the king lifted up his eyes to heaven?
questions.explanation: At the end of the days his understanding returned to him, and he blessed the Most High and praised and honored him who lives forever.

answers.text: He was slain that night by his own counselors
His understanding returned to him and he blessed the Most High
He set up another great image of gold
He sent Daniel away from Babylon for good
